Nifty 50 rose 2.40% to 24,537 on narrow participation
Today’s read
The biggest names carried the session. The fifty most traded stocks returned +3.03% weighted by turnover, against +1.05% for the median stock, a gap of 2.0 percentage points, so most stocks did worse than the busiest names suggest.

Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited rose 7.3% on 118 times its usual volume. Its exchange filing that session was about quarterly results, “Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.”.

JSW Dulux Limited rose 4.4% on 72 times its usual volume. Its exchange filing that session was about guidance or investor update, “Link of Recording”.

PDS Limited rose 11.8% on 174 times its usual volume. Its exchange filing that session was about guidance or investor update, “Investor Presentation”.

Gujarat Natural Resources Limited rose 14.9% on 95 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Dividend stocks: Coal India, TCS, HUDCO, HCL Tech, GAIL among top 10 dividend paying stocks - Check yield, annual return”.
